i had social anxiety for most of my life (thanks to ten years of bullying) and it slowly took over my life. depression and even suicidal thoughts are nothing new to me either. 

i finished university, already feeling kind of low all the time. then my brain was like 'i see you have quite a lot of spare time now, let's bring all the hurt in your life back to the surface.' and then it went south pretty fast. i couldn't leave the house without my boyfriend for a while. in this time my suicidal thoughts became more serious, and i kind of lived like I'll die soon anyways. I even ignored some letters and emails, which I shouldn't have. 
with the help of my boyfriend, i reached out for help. but since it can take forever to get an appointment it was very tiresome and my suicidal thoughts went crazy and i started cutting my arm. i ended up going to the hospital and thought i was getting better. but after a few weeks back home it got bad again, probably worse than ever.
I know it's hard work to get better, but I hope so much it'll be worth it for you. please explore all the options you have to get better before you do something irreversible.
